referenceChanges.what: Every layout.json and the manifest were re-rendered after the edge-width and type-role work; all 128 PNGs stayed byte-identical and shoot-design --check passed.
referenceChanges.why: The references were re-measured with the current renderer so every gate reads the same numbers; no design input changed, so no pixel moved.

referenceChanges.what: New design-derived variants for a game without music: S11 without the Music switch and Music volume rows (the rows below close up) and S6 without the Music key (Sound and Vibration share the row in two columns). The base references are unchanged.
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L1 (approved 2026-09-30): the settings and pause rules hide the Music rows and key when the game has no music, and Line Siege has none, so the base frames could never be matched honestly.

referenceChanges.what: The Persian level numbers of S8 use line height 1.45 (the token levelNumber.arabicLineHeight and the mockup rule .ar .lt b); the fa renders of s8-levels changed, the en renders did not.
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L2 (approved 2026-09-30): at line height 1.0 iOS clips the tops of Vazirmatn digits, a player-visible defect, so the token and the mockup changed together.

referenceChanges.what: New design-derived S7 win variant for score-rated games: the moves line becomes the Shell's score line result.win.score-line ('Score 1,840 – best 1,840', Persian digits in fa). The base reference keeps '7 moves – par 7'.
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L3 (approved 2026-09-30): games whose levels are rated by score (Line Siege) have no par, so their win card shows the score and the level's best instead of moves against par.

referenceChanges.what: Design input only: Line Siege's how-to-play step 4 and tutorial step 4 now say the monsters march closer every few blocks, in all four languages, in the copy deck and in the mockup's embedded deck. No frame draws step 4 (S13 shows step 2), so no reference pixel changed.
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L4 (approved 2026-09-30): the old text promised a march after every block, which the tuned cadence contradicts; 'every few blocks' holds for any march interval of 2 or more.

referenceChanges.what: The S11 settings footer's version line has no 6 px flex gap any more: 'Version 1.0.0 (8)' is one line of text with the copy deck's single space; only the autosave note keeps its 6 px icon gap. settings.version is 2.6 pt narrower (en) and 2.3 pt (fa).
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L5 (approved 2026-09-30): the mockup's .set-foot span{gap:6px} turned the version placeholder into its own flex item, unlike every other label and value pair; the mockup was corrected instead of waiving it.

referenceChanges.what: Design input only: the copy deck (and the mockup's embedded deck) gained consent.tracking.usage-description, the text iOS shows in Apple's tracking prompt, in en, de, fa and ckb. No frame draws it (the S3 consent moment is held before Google's form and Apple's prompt), so no reference pixel changed.
referenceChanges.why: Owner decision O1 (2026-09-30): the app follows Apple's App Tracking Transparency rules and asks for tracking permission after the consent form, with a usage description in all four languages.

referenceChanges.what: The light theme's dangerFill changed from #FFD9DD to #FFDCDF (same hue and saturation, lighter): the S11 danger row tile, the S12 error note fill and the S14 reset dialog's hold fill and art tile. The light-en and light-fa renders of s11-settings, s11-settings--no-music, s12-error and s14-reset-all-progress changed; dark #4A1F3A and every other render are unchanged.
referenceChanges.why: Owner decision O5 (2026-09-30): every text meets WCAG 4.5:1 in every state; the danger label on the growing hold fill read 4.43:1 on #FFD9DD and reads 4.52:1 on #FFDCDF.

referenceChanges.what: New design-derived S6 variants for a game without solver hints: the S5 top bar under the scrim has no hint key and its row ends with the undo key (derive: hide .gtb > .ibtn.sm:last-child). Variants now compose, so a game without music and without hints (Line Siege) uses s6-pause--no-music--no-hints. The base and s6-pause--no-music are unchanged.
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L8 (approved 2026-09-30): games whose rules give no solver hints show no hint key (the hasHints game fact), so the base S6 frame could never be matched honestly.

referenceChanges.what: The Persian score value of the S7 win card (type role scoreValue, 44 px display) uses line height 1.45 (the token scoreValue.arabicLineHeight and the mockup rule .ar .sc-v); the light-fa and dark-fa renders of s7-result-win and s7-result-win--score changed, the en renders did not.
referenceChanges.why: Lead decision L9 (approved 2026-09-30): at line height 1.0 iOS clips the tops of the Persian score digits (ink 29.0 vs 37.7 pt), a player-visible defect, so the token and the mockup changed together, as L2 did for the level numbers.

referenceChanges.what: New design-derived variant of the S14 reset dialog for a game without music: the dimmed Settings under the dialog has no Music switch and volume rows (a background variant; no element of the frame changes). The base reference is unchanged.
referenceChanges.why: Round-4 fix R3S-G17 (approved by the lead with the round-4 plan, 2026-09-30): Line Siege has no music, so the Settings under the scrim could never match the base frame.

referenceChanges.what: The System row of the Language page (S11a, and under the S14 restart dialog) names the render language, as the phone the capture launches does: 'سیستم (فارسی)' in fa instead of the mockup's fixed sample 'System (English)'. The fa renders of s11a-language and s14-restart-to-apply changed; en is unchanged. No product change: frames.json designFixes re-renders the sample, the design file is untouched.
referenceChanges.why: Round-4 fix R3S-G17 (approved by the lead with the round-4 plan, 2026-09-30): the mockup filled {languageName} with English in every language, which no correct app can show.

referenceChanges.what: Every layout.json and the manifest were re-rendered with the round-4 renderer and map: each text run records its own tilt, the S14 progress-restored layout records the banner mask of Home under the dialog, the S12 state cards no longer pair their stand-in heading with premium.top-bar.title, and the map metadata gained the card surface of home.daily-card (L7, no pixel change) and the hint key's hasHints condition. Apart from the changes above, all 124 other PNGs are byte-identical.
referenceChanges.why: The round-4 gates read these measurements; no design input changed for them, so no other pixel moved (lead, 2026-09-30).
